topics.title: Great Nicobar Island Infrastructure Project and Environmental Concerns
topics.summary: The National Green Tribunal (NGT) and Union Environment Ministry continue monitoring the ₹72,000-crore Great Nicobar project, balancing strategic maritime infrastructure against tribal rights and biodiversity loss.
key_takeaways: Impact on Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) like the Shompen and Nicobarese.
Threat to the nesting grounds of the Leatherback Sea Turtle at Galathea Bay National Park.
Strategic significance of the International Container Transshipment Terminal (ICTT) in the Indo-Pacific.

topics.title: RBI's Framework for Self-Regulatory Organisations (SROs) in FinTech
topics.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) finalized the framework for recognizing Self-Regulatory Organisations in the Financial Technology sector to promote responsible innovation and compliance.
key_takeaways: SROs will bridge the gap between FinTech entities and the regulator.
Focus on customer protection, data privacy, and cybersecurity compliance.
Encourages voluntary code of conduct without stifling technological advancements.

topics.title: Progress on ISRO's Gaganyaan Mission & Pad Abort Tests
topics.summary: ISRO advances preparations for India's first human spaceflight mission, conducting critical safety tests for the Crew Escape System and environmental control systems.
key_takeaways: LVM3 (GSLV Mk III) re-engineered to meet human-rating specifications.
Deployment of 'Vyommitra', the humanoid robot, for uncrewed precursor missions.
Establishment of astronaut recovery protocols with the Indian Navy and Coast Guard.

topics.title: India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) Strategic Review
topics.summary: Discussions resume on operationalizing the IMEC route to enhance multi-modal connectivity, trade efficiency, and supply chain resilience between Asia, the Arabian Gulf, and Europe.
key_takeaways: Counterpart to China's Belt and Road Initiative (BRI).
Includes railway lines, ship-to-rail transit networks, electricity cables, and green hydrogen pipelines.
Geopolitical significance in light of Middle Eastern stability and Red Sea security issues.

topics.title: Delimitation Commission and Article 82 of the Indian Constitution
topics.summary: Debates intensify regarding the upcoming post-2026 delimitation exercise, highlighting representation imbalances between North and South Indian states based on demographic trends.
key_takeaways: Article 82 mandates the readjustment of seats after each census, frozen until the first census after 2026 via the 84th Constitutional Amendment Act.
Federal governance implications regarding population control incentives versus parliamentary representation.
Proposed mechanisms like weighted voting or expanding the Rajya Sabha's scope to address federal friction.
